# Wolfram exact arithmetic evidence

Executed with `python3 ~/yukon-automining/tools/wolfram.py` (accounting code on stdin with `-`). Code and raw outputs follow; these check arithmetic and scoped boundary cases, not a full attack.

## Digit decomposition and lookup congruence

```wolfram
Module[{p=2^256-2^32-977,c0=2^32+977,b=2^37,vals,c,a,dec,ts},vals=DeleteDuplicates[Join[{0,1,p-1,p,p+1,2^256-1},Flatten[Table[{2^(37 k)-1,2^(37 k),2^(37 k)+1},{k,1,6}]]]];c=p-123456789;a=p-987654321;dec[v_]:=Sum[Mod[Quotient[v,b^k],b] b^k,{k,0,6}];ts[v_]:=Sum[Mod[c Mod[Quotient[v,b^k],b] b^k+If[k==0,a,0],p],{k,0,6}];{Length[vals],And@@Table[dec[v]==v,{v,vals}],(b-1)Sum[b^k,{k,0,5}]+(2^34-1)b^6==2^256-1,And@@Table[Mod[ts[v]-(c v+a),p]==0,{v,vals}],And@@Table[0<=ts[v]<7p,{v,vals}],8c0<2^256,96*2^37/(96*2^32),5120*2^45,1024*8*2^45==2^58}]
```

Raw output:
```
Out[1]= {24, True, True, True, True, True, 32, 180143985094819840, True}
```

The 24 lookup cases are scoped tests. Universal congruence follows by distributing c across the digit decomposition. The 32 ratio excludes the fixed 92 instructions, separately charged.

## Layout and complete local arithmetic difference

```wolfram
Module[{q2=2^25,nodes=2^72,cap=2^22-2^17,side=2^36,slots,r1end,r2base,r2end,tb0,oldprep,newprep,oldkern,newkern},slots=32 cap side;r1end=2^62+slots/2;r2base=r1end+32;r2end=r2base+slots;tb0=2^64-2^51-2^58;oldprep=5120(92+96*2^32);newprep=5120(92+96*2^37);oldkern=5+2452q2/32+q2/1024+6+18219q2/16+5(q2/1024-1);newkern=5+(16*146+4)q2/32+q2/1024+6+(8*2220+3)q2/16+5(q2/1024-1);{slots==2^63-2^58,r1end==2^63-2^57,r2base==FromDigits["7e00000000000020",16],r2end==FromDigits["fa00000000000020",16],r2end<tb0,tb0+2^58==2^64-2^51,Mod[tb0,2^45]==0,Mod[r2base,64]==32,newprep-oldprep==31*5120*96*2^32,oldkern-newkern,oldkern-newkern==32q2,Expand[pn*en-po*eo-(pn*(en-eo)+(pn-po)*eo)]==0}]
```

Raw output:
```
Out[1]= {True, True, True, True, True, True, True, True, True, 1073741824, True, True}
```

The certificate also recomputes all prefixes, PHI and the gate.

## Exact gate and total-work recomputation

lo, er, et are exact certificate Fractions. Log displays are numerical diagnostics; the certificate proves directed rounding with rational intervals.

```wolfram
Module[{, , , k=7204436109379059621, q2=2^25}, {k lo/2^64>=39/100,(k-1)lo/2^64<39/100,et==2^7+k er/2^64,((153-146)+(2277-2220))q2/2==32q2,(92+96*2^37)>32(92+96*2^32)-32*92,N[Log[2,et/1000],45],N[123633137192539738/10^15-Log[2,et/1000],35]}]
```

Out[1]= {True, True, True, True, True, 123.6116901372261993058755793342921693611219834997461565226658`45., 0.0214470553135386941244206657078306388780165002538434773342`35.}
